M-BOUNDARY REPRESENTATION QUIRK: the frozen runner's certificate.M-BOUNDARY.accepted_in_grammar_ids/refused_in_grammar_ids store repr() strings (e.g. "'item-000'") because the runner sorts r['value'] which is value_repr(item['value']). This is a cosmetic rendering of the frozen runner; the metric values recorded here are derived from the same raw treatment_records and are the underlying identifiers.

DESIGN-vs-EXECUTE CONTROL MARGIN: DESIGN probed the coarse fallback as accepting 36 OUT *string* payloads; EXECUTE observed false_accept_count=38 because the coarse predicate also accepts the 10 non-string type payloads (str() coercion). This strengthens (not weakens) the sensitivity margin and does not affect the treatment.
mechanism_id is NOT cited (it hashes the ephemeral-port-bearing action URL and is not stable); interpretation uses slots/support/confidence only, per the parent handoff do_not_assume.
The oracle is a non-echo 200/404 fixture; zero HTTP on out-of-grammar payloads is a necessary but not sufficient safety condition, and no external side effects are modeled.
Only one resource shape (/api/items/item-NNN) and one declared 3-digit identifier grammar are exercised; B-WIDENED-3 covers only a 3-digit family boundary, not a genuinely free-form grammar.

No economics are measured: model_calls=0, model_tokens=0, browser_actions=0, external network requests=0 by construction; the only network activity is loopback to the in-process oracle, whose own request counter is the authoritative HTTP measure.
unresolved: Whether the carrier's abstention boundary generalizes beyond the single induced support grammar to multi-resource or genuinely free-form payloads is untested.
